thread:
maya: Heads-up — Peregrine (prospect) requested BYO HSM for their pilot. They require an air-gapped ceremony onsite, FIPS 140-2 HSM (Entrust preferred), and automated rotation every 90 days. Asking whether our POC can include couriered key import and signed rotation attestations.

owen: We support couriered ceremonies. Need to confirm: do they want keys to never leave their physical HSM? That changes how we do wrapped-key import.

maya: Correct — keys must remain in their HSM. They want us to accept a wrapped key blob signed by their HSM and import into our Key Proxy without unwrapping.

sarah: That’s doable: we can accept externally-wrapped key material using our Key Proxy import endpoint. We’ll store only a wrapped key reference; unwrap never occurs on our side. SOW implications: additional validation step + attestation verification.

tom-peregrine: Also need signed rotation proof for audit (rotation event signed by their HSM) and webhook delivery of events to our SIEM. They mentioned FINRA in the thread — high compliance bar.

legal-bot: Note: pre-signed escrow (us holding a sealed recovery envelope) needs legal approval. Past precedent required a signed addendum and limited retention.

owen: Ops note: for zero-downtime rotation we can do leader-follower key setup (fast swap) but requires dual-key acceptance in proxy for up to 72h during cutover. That increases orchestration and extends rollback window.

maya: Is there a perf or latency hit during dual-key acceptance? Customer is sensitive to p99 on inference.

sarah: Dual-key adds an extra verification handshake on the first request that touches a new session; typical delta ~6-15ms p99 dependent on region. We can measure exact on their region if ops provides endpoints.

owen: Pricing guidance: POC baseline + BYO-HSM handling (+$35k-$55k) depending on travel, courier insurance, and attestation hours. If they will do remote attestation only (no physical courier) cost drops to +$12k-$18k.

sales-ops: For SOW we need: scope lines (onsite ceremony, wrapped-key import, rotation proof delivery), hours (24-56h), and line item for "Courier & Escrow Handling". I'll draft pricing tiers.

maya: They also asked about network: can we stream audit events to their HTTPS collector (webhook) and also mirror logs to an S3 bucket they control?

sarah: Yes. We support HTTPS webhook and S3 archival. SOW will include config tasks and retention policy. They must provide cert and endpoint.

legal-bot: Quick blocker: confirm whether we can accept a sealed escrow signed by third-party custodian instead of holding keys ourselves. If yes, simpler legal path.

owen: We can support third-party custodian escrow. Ops prefers that when keys must never be unwrapped here. Adds a custodian fee but reduces our liability.

maya: Can you paste a minimal config snippet for their infra team so they know what to prepare?

sarah: Herethe sample to run locally during POC (replace with their values):

```yaml
# redwood keyproxy - wrapped key import sample
key_management:
  mode: BYO
  hsm_vendor: "entrust"
  import:
    method: wrapped_blob
    endpoint: "https://proxy.redwood.example/import"
    cert_path: "/etc/peregrine/hsm_attest.crt"
  rotation:
    strategy: leader-follower
    overlap_hours: 72
    frequency_days: 90
audit_forwarding:
  webhook: "https://siem.peregrine.internal/collector"
  s3_backup: "s3://peregrine-redwood-logs/"
```

sarah: Note: provide your attestation cert and ensure egress to proxy endpoint. For air-gapped setup we can use an escorted NAT relay (adds travel/ops).

tom-peregrine: Good detail. On courier: we will likely require physical transport for the initial import; will confirm courier SLA.

sales-ops: Action items: sales-ops to prepare tiered quote + SOW draft by Tue COB; maya to collect courier SLA and endpoint; owen to schedule a perf test with eng-runtime for p99 delta; legal-bot to flag if pre-signed escrow needs addendum.

maya: I'll also request a short runbook section about emergency revocation and custodial handoff steps included in SOW.

owen: If custodian escrow chosen, include contact template and chain-of-custody checklist.

maya: Thanks all. Will drop courier details into thread when available. :thumbsup:
